reconciliation_notes: The page's own headline arithmetic (24 Original + 19 Licensed = 43) is CORRECT. An earlier automated single-fetch summary of this same page mis-classified 'The First' (Henry Creel, Stranger Things Chapter 2) as Original when it is actually Licensed; correcting that one row makes the hand-count of the list match the page's stated 24/19 split exactly. The separate Category:Killers page lists 45 pages, but that count includes 3 unreleased/upcoming killers (The Judgment - Ch.41 Chorus of Sin, 25 Aug 2026; Art the Clown - Ch.42 Terrifier, unreleased; Frank Stone 'The Champion' - Ch.43 The Casting of Frank Stone, ~March 2027) and is MISSING The Cenobite (Elliot Spencer, Ch.21 Hellraiser) due to an apparent wiki categorization gap (verified The Cenobite is real and released via its own character page). 45 (category) - 3 (upcoming, not yet in game) + 1 (Cenobite, mis-categorized but real/released) = 43, matching the main page. The 43 entries below are the confirmed CURRENTLY RELEASED roster as of 2026-07-06; upcoming/unreleased killers are intentionally excluded from this list (see notes).

killers.title: The Good Guy
killers.note: Child's Play franchise. The character is globally known by the nickname 'Chucky', but that is NOT the official in-game killer title - the title is 'The Good Guy' (referencing the 'Good Guy' doll brand). 'Charles Lee Ray' is the human serial killer whose soul possesses the doll. Same trap pattern as Springtrap/Animatronic below.

killers.title: The Unknown

killers.title: The Lich
killers.note: Wizards of the Coast's Dungeons & Dragons. IMPORTANT: do not confuse with 'The First' (killer #42 below) - both characters are associated with the name 'Vecna' in DBD, but they are two DIFFERENT playable killers. 'The Lich' = the classic D&D villain Vecna. 'The First' = Henry Creel from Stranger Things, whose alter-ego/villain alias is ALSO 'Vecna' (via the show's crossover lore) as well as 'One'. See note on 'The First' entry.

killers.title: The Animatronic
killers.note: TRAP CASE (given/confirmed): the official in-game killer title is 'The Animatronic'. 'Springtrap' is one specific animatronic suit/skin worn by William Afton, not the killer's official title.

killers.title: The Krasue
killers.note: Recent release (23 Sept 2025), chapter/date verified directly on character page. Inspired by Thai folklore (Krasue spirit) but is an original BHVR character design, not a licensed property.

killers.title: The First
killers.note: TRAP CASE (newly identified, analogous to Animatronic/Springtrap): the official in-game killer title is 'The First'. The character is also widely known by the alter-ego names 'Vecna' and 'One' (from the Stranger Things show), but NEITHER of those is the DBD title. This is further confusing because a SEPARATE, different DBD killer ('The Lich', entry above) has 'Vecna' as its actual character name. Very recent release (27 Jan 2026) - flagged as higher-risk despite direct verification. An earlier automated wiki-summary mis-classified this killer as 'Original'; it is actually Licensed (Stranger Things/Netflix).

killers.title: The Slasher
killers.note: Friday the 13th franchise, re-added via the 'Jason Universe Initiative (2023)' licensing deal. Very recent release (16 June 2026, less than a month before this research date) - flagged as higher-risk despite direct verification via two independent page fetches. Chapter 39 ('All-Kill: Comeback') introduced no killer, only survivor Kwon Tae-young, which is why killer chapters skip from 38 to 40.
